verdicts.reason: The addition of 'with the image reflected in it' introduces a second predicate beyond the stated semantic target. The source already contains one predicate ('Show a kitchen with the color palette of the image'). Adding reflection creates a compound predicate that bundles two distinct visual constraints: color palette application AND reflection effect. This violates the single-edit requirement.

The deletion of 'that uses the color palette of the image' removes exactly one meaningful semantic constraint while preserving the core subject ('An interior kitchen scene'). The resulting text is fluent, grammatically correct, and strictly weaker. All supplied positive images show kitchens that do apply the warm coral/orange palette from the reference, but the weaker query no longer requires this constraint, making it compatible with a broader set of kitchen images.
